body:
Not Bagehot wrote:
> 
> On Tue, 16 Feb 1999 23:15:20 -0800, Dan Clore
> <clore@columbia-center.org> wrote:
> >
> >The damage done by ABC's hit piece on Earth First! is
> >tremendous. Hard working environmental activists, who
> >regularly place their bodies on the line to protect the
> >earth, should not be subjected to such blather.
> 
> Nobody should be exempt from criticism, particularly the kind of
> people who would readily agree with the Unabomber that '[t]he
> Industrial Revolution and its consequences have been a disaster for
> the human race.'  When it comes to facile blather, ABC would be hard
> put to better the ugly superstitious misanthropism of Earth First!er
> Judi Bari: 'I believe the Earth is going to rise up and throw us
> off...The Earth's failure to be able to sustain this kind of life will
> cause it to collapse. I'm sure life will survive that, but I don't
> think that humans will. I don't know if we deserve to.'

How is that any more blather than what we hear from politicians EVERY
day? Did she threaten anyone?
-- 
Joe Zorzin, Practicing Forester
http://forestmeister.com
-
